General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Increase fiber gradually and drink enough water.

📖 How to use

  1. Tick every high-fiber food you ate today.
  2. Add custom entries with fiber grams from labels.
  3. Watch your total climb toward the target bar.
  4. Aim to hit 25g (women) or 30g (men) daily.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How much fiber do I need?

About 25g per day for women and 30g for men are common reference targets; this tool lets you track against both.

How do I log my foods?

Tick each food you ate today, or add a custom entry with its fiber grams from the nutrition label.

Are the built-in values exact?

Yes — fiber grams vary by brand and portion; treat the built-in values as typical averages.
